text:
To: Warehouse Team
From: Corinne Aldous, Inventory Control
Subject: Stocktake next week

Our annual stocktake will take place on Wednesday and Thursday of next week. [1] During these two days, no goods will be dispatched or received, and customers have been informed accordingly. Each team will be responsible for counting the items in its own section, [2] a second person will verify the figures. Counts must be entered on the handheld scanners as they are [3], not at the end of the shift, since errors are far more likely to occur when figures are recalled from memory. Anyone who notices damaged goods during the count should tag them [4] and report them to me. Refreshments will be provided in the break room throughout both days.

choices: The exercise is required by our auditors and must be completed before the end of the financial year.
Several staff members have asked whether overtime will be paid for work carried out during the stocktake.
The new scanners were delivered last week and have been tested by the team leaders in the loading area.
Last year's count revealed a discrepancy of less than one percent, which was considered excellent by the auditors.
questions.explanation: The next sentence describes conditions during the two days, so the preceding sentence explains the exercise.
The verification by a second person follows the first count.
'as they are made' is a passive construction with a past participle.
An adverb is needed to modify the verb 'tag'.

text:
Airlines Turn to Biofuels

Airlines are under growing pressure to reduce their carbon emissions, and many are turning to biofuels made from waste cooking oil and agricultural residues. [1] Nordair, a regional carrier, now blends sustainable fuel into about 10 percent of its supply, and it plans to double that proportion within three years. The main obstacle is cost, [2] biofuel is currently two to three times as expensive as conventional kerosene. Industry analysts say that production will need to expand [3] prices are to fall. Governments could help by offering tax incentives to producers, [4] some experts doubt that this alone would be enough. Passengers, meanwhile, appear willing to pay a modest surcharge if it is clearly explained.

choices: The shift has gathered pace in recent years, and several carriers have now signed long-term supply agreements.
Air travel is expected to double over the next twenty years, mainly because of growth in emerging economies.
Aircraft engines were not originally designed to run on fuel derived from agricultural waste products.
Several environmental groups have criticized the industry for relying too much on offsets to meet its targets.
questions.explanation: The next sentence offers an example of an airline's approach, supporting the idea of a developing trend.
The cost is the main obstacle because biofuel is more expensive.
Production needs to expand significantly if prices are to fall; the structure is conditional.
'although' concedes that incentives would help but may not be enough.

text:
Dear Ms. Nakamura,

Thank you for your inquiry regarding the lease of office space at Riverside Plaza. We currently have two suites available, [1] one on the fourth floor and one on the seventh. Both are fitted with air conditioning and high-speed cabling, and tenants have access to shared meeting rooms. [2] The fourth-floor suite offers 120 square meters and is available immediately, whereas the larger suite on the seventh floor will be vacant from the beginning of January. Rents include service charges but [3] utilities. A viewing can be arranged at your convenience, and I would be [4] to answer any questions you may have beforehand.

Best regards,
Daniel Osei
Leasing Manager, Riverside Plaza

questions.explanation: 'namely' introduces the specification of the two suites.

choices: Riverside Plaza is located beside the river, opposite the central station and a short walk from the main shopping street.
The details of each suite are set out below, together with the monthly rent and the terms of the lease.
Several of our current tenants are law firms and technology companies that have been with us for many years.
The building was awarded an environmental certificate last year in recognition of its efficient use of energy.
questions.explanation: The next sentences give details of the suites, so the preceding sentence introduces them.
'include ... but exclude utilities' requires a parallel base-form verb.
'I would be delighted to' is a standard polite formula.

text:
ATTENTION: PARKING GARAGE USERS

The underground garage at Meridian Tower will be closed for resurfacing from Friday at 6 p.m. until Monday at 6 a.m. [1] During this period, tenants holding permits may park in the Albion Street lot, which is a three-minute walk from the main entrance. [2] Vehicles remaining in the garage after 6 p.m. on Friday will be towed at the owner's expense. [3] , deliveries to the loading dock will be unaffected, since the dock is reached by a separate ramp. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your [4] while the work is carried out. Inquiries may be addressed to the building manager.

choices: The work is necessary to repair damage caused by water that has gradually seeped through the concrete.
The tower was built in 2004 and houses the offices of more than forty companies on twenty-two floors.
The garage has space for about three hundred vehicles and is open around the clock throughout the year.
The building manager is considering adding charging points for electric cars on the lowest level.
questions.explanation: The sentence explains the reason for closure before the practical arrangements.

choices: The Albion Street lot has been used by the building in the past, so no extra permits will be required.
Tenants are therefore asked to remove their vehicles before the closure and not to leave any belongings behind.
Bicycle racks are located by the main entrance and will remain accessible throughout the weekend.
Cleaning of the lobby will be carried out on Saturday morning and will not affect access to the building.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says vehicles remaining will be towed, so the preceding sentence requests removal.
The sentence introduces what is not affected: a contrast with the garage closure.
'patience' means tolerance; 'patients' is a homophone distractor.

text:
Linwood Language Exchange – Practice Makes Perfect

If you are learning a foreign language, one of the best ways to improve is to speak with a native speaker. [1] Linwood Language Exchange connects learners from around the world for regular conversations by video. [2] You choose the language you want to practice and the one you can offer in return, and our system finds a partner whose profile [3] yours. There are no lessons or fees: members simply talk, correct each other, and make friends. [4] you join before the end of the month, you will receive three months of premium membership, which includes access to themed discussion groups. Visit linwood.example to create your free profile.

choices: Unfortunately, such opportunities are hard to find unless you live in a large city or travel frequently.
Many learners say that fear of making mistakes is the main reason they avoid speaking in a foreign language.
Textbooks and mobile applications can teach vocabulary and grammar, but they rarely prepare you for real conversation.
Teachers recommend that students listen to the radio and watch films in order to train their ears.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says Linwood connects learners, offering a solution to the problem of finding speakers.

choices: Our members come from over eighty countries and between them speak more than forty different languages.
The process takes less than five minutes, and the first meeting can be arranged within a day.
The company was founded by two teachers who met while studying abroad at a university in Spain.
Languages in demand include Spanish, Mandarin, and Portuguese, according to figures from the previous year.
questions.explanation: The next sentence explains how matching works, so the preceding sentence gives its simplicity.
'whose profile matches yours' needs a present simple verb.
'If you join' sets the condition for the offer.

text:
Hotel Events Coordinator – The Grand Meridian

The Grand Meridian, a five-star hotel in the center of Vienna, is looking for an Events Coordinator to manage weddings, conferences, and private dinners. [1] You will work with clients from the first inquiry to the final invoice, and you will supervise a team of temporary staff on the day of each event. The candidate should have at least three years' experience in hospitality and an excellent command of English and German. A [2] manner and the ability to remain calm under pressure are essential. [3] Evening and weekend work will be required, time off in lieu is provided. Please submit your application [4] our website, including a cover letter that describes your most challenging event to date.

choices: This is a varied role for someone who enjoys detailed planning and thrives in a fast-moving environment.
The hotel has two ballrooms and nine smaller rooms and has won several awards for its service and cuisine.
Our guests include business travelers, tourists, and diplomats who visit the city for official meetings.
The events department currently has six employees who report to the director of sales and marketing.
questions.explanation: The next sentences describe duties, so the preceding sentence characterizes the role.
An adjective is needed before 'manner'.
'Although' concedes the unsocial hours and mentions the compensation.
One applies 'through' a website.

text:
Westbury Bank – Protecting Yourself from Fraud

Fraudulent e-mails and phone calls are becoming more sophisticated, [1] it is important to know how to recognize them. Westbury Bank will never ask you to disclose your password or full PIN, whether by telephone, text message, or e-mail. [2] If you receive a message that asks you to click on a link and enter your details, do not do so. Instead, contact us directly using the number printed on your card. [3] you suspect that your account has been compromised, call our fraud line immediately; it is staffed twenty-four hours a day. We will [4] any unauthorized transactions that are reported promptly and will issue you with a new card at no charge.

questions.explanation: The growing sophistication of fraud is the reason it is important to know the signs.

choices: Our branches are open from nine to five on weekdays, and the telephone service operates throughout the weekend.
Messages that create a sense of urgency, such as threats to close your account, should be treated with suspicion.
Customers who bank online are advised to log out of their accounts when they have finished using them.
Debit cards issued by Westbury Bank contain a chip that makes them more difficult to copy than the older cards.
questions.explanation: The next sentence tells customers what to do with such messages, so the preceding sentence characterizes them.
A conditional is needed: if you suspect the account has been compromised.
The bank will 'refund' unauthorized transactions.

text:
To: Sales Associates
From: Ethan Park, Store Manager
Subject: Holiday schedule

As the holiday season approaches, we expect customer traffic to rise sharply. [1] To ensure that the store is adequately staffed, all associates will be required to work at least two weekend shifts in December. [2] Requests for time off must be submitted in writing by November 10, and those received after this date will be considered only if cover can be arranged. Part-time employees will be offered additional hours, [3] full-time staff will be paid overtime when they work more than forty hours. Please [4] that the store will remain open until 10 p.m. on the three Fridays before the holiday.

choices: Last year, sales in December accounted for nearly a third of our total revenue for the entire year.
The store has been redecorated for the season, and the window displays will be changed at the beginning of next week.
Our supplier has promised to deliver additional stock to cover the expected increase in demand for gift items.
Several new part-time employees have been recruited and will receive training during the first week of the month.
questions.explanation: The next sentence tells staff what is required, so the preceding sentence explains why.
'Accordingly' introduces the consequence of the staffing needs.
'whereas' contrasts the arrangement for part-time and full-time staff.
'Please note that' is the standard formula.

text:
Product Review: Zephyr Wireless Headphones

I bought the Zephyr headphones after my previous pair broke on a long flight. [1] The sound quality is impressive for the price, with deep bass and clear vocals. The noise-canceling feature, however, [2] expectations: it removes the hum of an airplane engine but does little against sudden noises such as announcements. [3] the battery is advertised as lasting thirty hours, I managed to get closer to twenty-five on a single charge. The ear cushions are comfortable but become warm after an hour or two. [4] those minor shortcomings, I would recommend the headphones to commuters and travelers looking for good value.

choices: I was looking for something reliable that would not cost as much as the leading brands.
The headphones are available in black, white, and a dark blue that matches many of my other accessories.
My brother owns a similar pair made by the same company and has had no problems for over a year.
The packaging included a hard case, a charging cable, and an adapter for use with airline entertainment systems.
questions.explanation: The next sentence evaluates the sound quality, so the preceding sentence gives the reviewer's expectations.
'fall short of expectations' is the fixed expression.
'Although' concedes the advertised battery life before reporting the actual figure.
'Despite' is followed by a noun phrase: 'those minor shortcomings'.

text:
Oakridge Hospital – Visiting Hours and Guidelines

Visiting hours on general wards are from 2 p.m. to 8 p.m. every day. [1] Visitors to the intensive care unit are limited to two at a time, and children under twelve are not permitted. [2] Flowers are not allowed in the maternity ward or in any area where patients have respiratory conditions. All visitors must wash their hands at the entrance and use the sanitizer provided at the foot of each bed. Anyone who has experienced symptoms of illness in the previous forty-eight hours [3] kindly refrain from visiting. [4] a patient is receiving treatment, nurses may ask visitors to wait outside for a short time.

choices: Different hours apply on some specialist wards, where patients require more rest or more intensive monitoring.
The hospital cafeteria is open to visitors from seven in the morning until eight in the evening each day.
Parking is free for the first hour and then charged at a rate of two dollars for each additional hour.
The hospital was founded in 1923 and now has more than six hundred beds, making it the largest in the region.
questions.explanation: The next sentences give specialist ward restrictions, so the preceding sentence announces that exceptions exist.

choices: Visitors who wish to stay overnight must obtain written permission from the ward sister well in advance.
Patients' rooms are small and cannot safely accommodate more than two visitors at the same time on any ward.
Wheelchairs are available at the main entrance for visitors who need help moving between wards.
Visitors are asked to turn off their phones or to set them to silent as a courtesy to patients.
questions.explanation: The next sentence is about flowers, so the preceding one concerns what visitors may bring or how many.
'should kindly refrain' is a formal instruction.
'While' means during the time that, so 'While a patient is receiving treatment' fits.

text: Hi Carol, Imran here. I'm calling a short meeting tomorrow at 9 a.m. to discuss the new client's requests. [1] It shouldn't take more than twenty minutes. I've attached the brief they sent, [2] I'd like you to read the section on deadlines beforehand. The client expects a first draft by Friday, [3] I'm worried that we may not be able to meet that date unless we divide the work today. Could you let me know which parts you [4] to take on? I'd suggest the budget and the timeline, but I'm happy to hear other ideas. The earlier we agree who does what, the more time we will have to review each other's work before the deadline.

choices: There are several points in the brief that I do not think we can accept without negotiation.
Our office will be closed on Monday for the national holiday, as it is every year at this time.
The client's headquarters are in Frankfurt, but their representatives will be visiting our city next month.
Please remember to bring your laptop and the notes you took during the call last Thursday.
questions.explanation: The next sentence says it will be short, so the preceding sentence gives the reason for the meeting.
The sentence adds a related request: attach the brief and ask her to read part of it.
The deadline is stated, but there is a worry about meeting it.
'which parts you would like to take on' is the correct structure.

text:
Nomination Form – Employee of the Year Award

Any employee may nominate a colleague for the Employee of the Year Award, with the exception of members of the selection committee. [1] Nominations must describe, in no more than 300 words, the specific contributions that make the nominee deserving of recognition. [2], evidence such as customer comments, performance data, or examples of improved processes will strengthen the nomination. The committee will give priority to achievements that have [3] a measurable benefit to the company. [4] a nominee is not selected in one year, he or she may be nominated again in the following one. Completed forms should be returned to the Human Resources office by December 1.

choices: Only staff who have completed at least twelve months of service by the closing date are eligible to be nominated.
The winner will receive a certificate, a financial prize, and a day of paid leave to be taken at their convenience.
Last year's award was presented to a member of the logistics team at the annual dinner in the new year.
The selection committee consists of six members drawn from different departments and meets four times a year.
questions.explanation: The next sentence is about nominations, so the preceding sentence is about who may be nominated.
'Where possible' is a fixed expression meaning whenever it is possible.
Achievements 'produce' a measurable benefit; the others do not fit.
'Even if a nominee is not selected' concedes the failure and adds that renomination is possible.

text:
Booking Confirmation – Seaview Holiday Cottages

Thank you for booking Cottage 6 for the week of July 12. [1] A deposit of $250 has been received, and the balance of $750 must be paid at least six weeks before your arrival. Check-in is from 4 p.m. and check-out is by 10 a.m. [2] Linens and towels are provided, [3] you are welcome to bring your own if you prefer. Pets are allowed only with our prior consent and are subject to an additional charge of $30. Cancellations made [4] four weeks of arrival will forfeit the deposit. We look forward to welcoming you. Please keep this confirmation and present it, together with photo identification, when you collect the keys on arrival.

choices: Your reservation is for four adults and two children and includes a parking space for one vehicle.
Cottage 6 was refurbished last winter and now has a new kitchen, a larger terrace, and underfloor heating.
The beach is five minutes from the cottage on foot, and the nearest village has two shops and a pub.
Seaview Holiday Cottages has been run by the same family for thirty years and manages twelve properties.
questions.explanation: The next sentence refers to a deposit, so the preceding sentence covers the reservation details.

choices: The key will be left in a safe beside the front door, and the code will be sent to you two days beforehand.
Early arrival or late departure may be possible on request, subject to the availability of the cottage.
Guests are reminded that smoking is prohibited inside the cottage and anywhere near the thatched roof.
A welcome pack including local milk, bread, and eggs will be waiting for you in the kitchen when you arrive.
questions.explanation: The sentence completes the information on check-in and check-out times.
Linens are provided, but guests may bring their own.
'within four weeks of arrival' refers to a cancellation period.

text:
To: All Branch Managers
From: Leonora Vance, Director of Retail Operations
Subject: Introduction of the new point-of-sale system

After two years of evaluation, the company has selected Tillpoint as its new point-of-sale system, and installation will begin in the northern region on March 3. [1] Each branch will be visited by a technician, who will [2] the equipment and train staff over a period of two days. During that time, the store may continue to trade, [3] transactions will be recorded manually and entered into the system once the installation is complete. Managers are asked to nominate one employee per shift to act as a local expert, [4] the others will turn to when problems arise. The full rollout is expected to be completed by the end of June. I am grateful for your cooperation as we make this important change.

choices: The system will replace the three different tools currently in use and bring all of our sales data into one place.
The northern region was chosen first because its branches are the smallest and the least affected by seasonal trade.
Tillpoint was selected from a shortlist of five suppliers after a trial in two stores over a period of several weeks.
A number of managers have expressed concern that the change will interfere with the holiday schedule in December.
questions.explanation: The next sentence describes the installation visit, so the preceding sentence presents the system and its purpose.
A technician will 'install' equipment; 'instill' means to gradually introduce an idea.
The store may trade, although transactions will be recorded manually.
'whom' is the object of the preposition 'to': someone the others will turn to.
